verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at motherduck.com/llms.txt. MotherDuck also publishes an llms-full.txt and serves many docs pages as markdown (.md URLs such as sharing-data.md and mcp.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. One probe of a malformed .md path (getting-started/.md) returned 404, while the getting-started.md form is cited as working. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown-docs conventions themselves.
